cards.card_text: Naomi says, "I went away full, but the LORD has brought me back empty." So she comes back from the land of Moab, and with her is her daughter-in-law Ruth the Moabitess.
cards.verse_text: After all, the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me.” So Naomi returned from the land of Moab with her daughter-in-law Ruth the Moabitess.
cards.snippet: …Naomi returned from the land of Moab with her daughter-in-law Ruth the Moabitess.

cards.card_text: Boaz asks the foreman of his harvesters, "Whose young woman is this?" The foreman answers, "She is the Moabitess who returned with Naomi from the land of Moab."
cards.verse_text: And Boaz asked the foreman of his harvesters, “Whose young woman is this?” The foreman answered, “She is the Moabitess who returned with Naomi from the land of Moab.

cards.card_text: On the day the man buys the land from Naomi and Ruth the Moabitess, what else must he do?
cards.verse_text: Then Boaz said, “On the day you buy the land from Naomi and also from Ruth the Moabitess, you must also acquire the widow of the deceased in order to raise up the name of the deceased on his inheritance.”

cards.card_text: Then Boaz announces he has acquired Ruth the Moabitess, Mahlon's widow, as his wife.
cards.verse_text: Moreover, I have acquired Ruth the Moabitess, Mahlon’s widow, as my wife, to raise up the name of the deceased through his inheritance, so that his name will not disappear from among his brothers or from the gate of his home.

cards.card_text: The two men who conspired against him are Zabad, son of Shimeath the Ammonitess, and Jehozabad, son of Shimrith the Moabitess.
cards.verse_text: Those who conspired against Joash were Zabad son of Shimeath the Ammonitess and Jehozabad son of Shimrith the Moabitess.
